Rent Roll Analysis.label: RENT ROLL ANALYSIS  —  Diagnostic Layer (Senior Living)

ANALYSIS on top. Raw rent roll below — paste from RentrollApp-Cl output. AR aging columns Q–T blank (paste from Analyzer AR Input or operator AR aging report). Care level: IL = Independent Living · AL = Assisted Living · MC = Memory Care.
B.  HEALTH CHECK  —  RR vs. Prop Info reconciliation
C.  CARE LEVEL CENSUS  —  Licensed beds, occupancy, and rate by level
D.  RESIDENT STATUS TAXONOMY  —  Where everyone stands
Tie-out: Occ + Vacant + Reserved = Licensed Beds  |  Occ Mkt + Vac Loss should tie to Section E GPR
E.  GPR RECONCILIATION  —  Three views of potential revenue
Market GPR  (all licensed beds × market rate × 12)
Loss to Lease  (Market − Scheduled on occupied)
LOC / Care Services Revenue  (Analyzer UW Output)
Economic GPR  (Market − LTL − Vac − Bad Debt + LOC)
F.  LENGTH OF STAY COHORT  —  How long residents have been here
G.  DAYS VACANT TRACKER  —  How long have the empty beds been empty?
Calculated from last discharge / move-out date. Blank discharge = unknown duration.
H.  DELINQUENCY  —  AR aging summary  (paste from Analyzer AR Input or operator aging report into cols Q–T)
I.  TOP-10 DELINQUENT RESIDENTS  —  Highest AR balances
Sorted by Balance descending. ✱✱ prefix = operator flagged for legal/collections action.
J.  ADMISSION VELOCITY  —  Recent move-ins (how fast is this property leasing?)
Move-ins within last N days. Annualized pace helps benchmark against stabilized absorption assumptions.
K.  PAYER MIX  —  Revenue resilience and reimbursement risk
Medicaid/Medicare are government-backed (lower default risk). Private pay is market-sensitive. LTC Insurance is contractual but requires prior auth.
L.  RATE PER BED BY CARE LEVEL  —  Pricing posture vs. comp set
Compare avg scheduled rate to market rate from Rental Comps tab. >5% below market = recapture opportunity.
M.  CHARGE VARIANCE  —  Actual vs. Scheduled  (catches billing errors / undocumented concessions)
N.  DEPOSIT COVERAGE ON DELINQUENT RESIDENTS  —  Recovery expectation at move-out
O.  MOVE-IN SEASONALITY  —  When did current residents sign on?
Distribution of current occupied residents by month-of-move-in. Predicts expiration clusters and occupancy seasonality.
P.  PRE-ADMISSION PIPELINE  —  Deposits paid / signed, not yet moved in
Detected as residents with Lease Start / Admission date in the future or with "Reserved" status in raw roll.
Q.  WING / CARE-LEVEL VACANCY CONCENTRATION  —  Catches localized issues
Vacancy clustered in one wing or care level often signals a localized problem (staffing, reputation, systems). Flag if any wing > 50% vacant.
